description: ZS-EVENT-001 payload of com.zoikosuite.accounting.journal.posted (general-ledger-svc, schema 1.0.0). Three posting paths emit it with different detail: the lifecycle path sends only journal_id and journal_number; the kernel and system-journal paths add lineage (book, posting execution, rule set and version, proposal hash, ledger watermark, posting date, fiscal period). Only the common core is required.
